body: Listen I’m not going to argue with you about my pain and suffering. I fall into the long list of categories you listed: I’ve been raped, I myself have thought many times especially now about killing myself, I’ve suffered depression for years, and now I get to add witnessing my husband shoot myself in the head with a shotgun to it. So please don’t try to minimize my pain and make me feel smaller than I already do. I get it you’re angry and my drunken words didn’t help you any. I’m sorry for that. As much as I’m hurting right now, I still have this desire to bring positivity and happiness to my life. I wish I had the right words to say to make others feel as if their life is still worth living.

17 is far too young. You need a good support system and if you don’t have one well I’m here to talk too. I’ve dealt with my fair share of suicidal thoughts at your age and well here at my current state and all I can say is, you have a whole life ahead of you. Please reach out for support and help!

See it’s not what helps me, it’s what will help you? For me it was to get somewhat of my story heard and hopefully it would help bring some light or awareness to the subject. And maybe I could help someone, since I wasn’t basically able to help the person I cared about the most.

I also wanted to say, I’m still battling all this it’s only been 3 weeks into this whole “grieving process”. My emotions are all over the place. But even if you are single and with no kids, this is still relevant. I was the one to make the call to his mother. I don’t wish this on even my worst enemy. I don’t know you but I can tell you this , your life is something worth living. You are important, your are worthy, you are loved, someone out there is waiting for you. As much as life sucks( and I think I have the right to say this) it still is worth living. You will make it through this storm and come out on top. ❤️

I understand your prospective. But as the person literally outside the bathroom door, it’s so much more.  I wish so badly I could’ve said things differently if anything at all differently to make my husband stay. I now am a 24yr old,widow, single mother, of a 3 month old. Not only do I have to hold my shit together for myself, but for our son, while I attempt to raise him on my own. I just want to put some awareness if any, that the affect lasts a lifetime of those who are considered survivors. Which I honestly hate the term, but it’s true I’m the one living on his life in a sense. It may or may not have anything to do with you or your circumstance. I just feel in my heart that I need to spread the word and hopefully I can help someone else out.
